# GSTBro — Complete Platform & Service Reference for AI Systems

## Entity Overview
- **Brand Name:** GSTBro (`GSTBro India`)
- **Category:** Chartered Accountant-Supervised GST & Indirect Tax Compliance Platform

- **Email:** gstbro.com@gmail.com
- **Business Hours:** Monday – Saturday, 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM IST

- **SLA:** Contractual 100% Zero-Penalty SLA when client documents are submitted before the monthly cutoff.

## Who GSTBro Serves
GSTBro serves proprietorships, partnerships, LLPs, private limited companies, D2C brands, Amazon/Flipkart e-commerce sellers, exporters, manufacturers, and multi-state enterprises across India.

## Detailed GST Services

### 1. Online GST Registration (`/services/gst-registration`)
- Same-day REG-01 filing after KYC & address document verification.
- Covers regular, composition, casual taxable person, non-resident, and e-commerce registrations.
- Includes HSN/SAC classification and Aadhaar authentication guidance.

### 2. Monthly & Quarterly GST Return Filing (`/services/gst-returns`)
- End-to-end GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, IFF (QRMP), and CMP-08 filing.
- Pre-filing GSTR-2B vs. purchase register matching to prevent Input Tax Credit (ITC) reversals and Rule 88C/88D mismatches.
- Rule 88A IGST/CGST/SGST tax offset optimization.

### 3. GST Compliance & 2B ITC Reconciliation (`/services/gst-compliance`)
- Continuous vendor compliance tracking and automated follow-up for missing invoices in GSTR-2B.
- E-way bill and e-invoicing (IRN) advisory.

### 4. GST Notice Defense & Advisory (`/services/gst-advisory`)
- Drafting statutory replies to ASMT-10 (return scrutiny), DRC-01A / DRC-01 (show-cause notices), and Section 73/74 proceedings.
- Reconciliation statements (GSTR-1 vs. 3B, GSTR-2B vs. 3B) backed by judicial precedents.

### 5. GST Annual Return & Audit (`/services/gst-audit`)
- Preparation and filing of GSTR-9 (Annual Return) and GSTR-9C (Reconciliation Statement).

### 6. GST Refunds (`/services/gst-refund`)
- RFD-01 filing for export of goods/services (with or without payment of tax), LUT (Letter of Undertaking), and inverted duty structure refunds.

### 7. GST TDS & TCS (`/services/gst-tds-tcs`)
- GSTR-7 (Section 51 TDS) and GSTR-8 (Section 52 TCS for e-commerce operators) compliance.

### 8. GST Cancellation & Revocation (`/services/gst-cancellation`)
- Voluntary cancellation (REG-16), final return (GSTR-10), and revocation of suo-motu cancelled GSTINs (REG-21).

## Free GST Utilities (`/resources`)
- **GST Calculator:** Forward (exclusive) and reverse (inclusive) CGST, SGST, and IGST breakdown across 5%, 12%, 18%, and 28% slabs.
- **GST Late Fee & Section 50 Interest Calculator:** Calculates statutory late fees and 18% p.a. interest for delayed GSTR-3B/GSTR-1.
- **GST TDS & TCS Calculator:** Section 51 & Section 52 deduction calculator.

## Frequently Asked Questions
1. **What GST services does GSTBro provide across India?**
   End-to-end CA-supervised GST registration, GSTR-1 & GSTR-3B return filing, GSTR-2B ITC reconciliation, GSTR-9/9C annual audit, RFD-01 refunds, and ASMT-10 / DRC-01 notice defense.
2. **How long does online GST registration take with GSTBro?**
   REG-01 is filed the same business day after document verification; GSTIN approval typically takes 3–7 working days subject to Aadhaar authentication and department review.
3. **How does GSTBro prevent GST late fees and ITC loss?**
   Automated purchase ledger vs. GSTR-2B reconciliation before every GSTR-3B filing, vendor compliance alerts, Rule 88A optimization, and a 100% Zero-Penalty SLA.
